title: Can one shared 24 GB cloud GPU serve accurate HIV chart answers to four clinicians at the same time?
summary: In a busy clinic, several providers may query patient charts simultaneously on one modest GPU server. We compared Med Agent Hub's single-call answer path against built-in ChartSearchAI on a shared 24 GB cloud GPU running Google Gemma 4 12B (configured for up to four concurrent requests), evaluating both clinical answer quality across 17 HIV scenarios (35 questions per setup) and live response speed with 1, 2, and 4 simultaneous clinicians.
takeaway: Med Agent Hub beat built-in ChartSearchAI by +8.7 points on clinical quality (87.2 vs. 78.5/100, zero unsafe answers, zero wrong dates, 82/82 verified citations vs. 1 wrong date and 4 unnecessary refusals on built-in), led by major gains on upcoming appointments (100 vs. 77/100), 5-turn medication adherence dialogs (+14.8 points), and pediatric growth tracking. Under multi-user load, Med Agent Hub scaled throughput 3.5x from 1 to 4 concurrent clinicians (3.7 to 13.0 answers/min, keeping median follow-up first-word wait at 3.2s with zero errors), whereas built-in ChartSearchAI saturated at 9.2 answers/min with a 17.8s median wait for the first word.
